items.title: Good in This World and the Hereafter
items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanah wa fil-akhirati hasanah wa qina 'adhaban-nar
items.translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
items.when_to_say: General supplication at any time.

items.title: Pour Upon Us Patience
items.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin
items.translation: Our Lord, pour upon us patience, make our steps firm, and help us against the disbelieving people.
items.when_to_say: During hardship, pressure, fear, or struggle.

items.title: Forgive Us and Have Mercy on Us
items.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na. Rabbana wa la tahmil 'alayna isran kama hamaltahu 'alalladhina min qablina. Rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bih. Wa'fu 'anna waghfir lana warhamna. Anta mawlana fansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin
items.translation: Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or make mistakes... pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so help us against the disbelieving people.
items.when_to_say: General supplication, especially for forgiveness and relief.

items.title: Do Not Let Our Hearts Deviate
items.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
items.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah innaka antal-Wahhab
items.translation: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself. Surely You are the Bestower.
items.when_to_say: When asking for steadfastness and guidance.

items.title: Forgive Our Sins
items.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana innana amanna faghfir lana dhunubana wa qina 'adhaban-nar
items.translation: Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
items.when_to_say: General repentance and renewal of faith.

items.title: Grant Me Good Offspring
items.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
items.transliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah innaka sami'ud-du'a'
items.translation: My Lord, grant me from Yourself good offspring. Surely You hear supplication.
items.when_to_say: When asking for righteous children.

items.title: We Have Wronged Ourselves
items.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasirin
items.translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we will surely be among the losers.
items.when_to_say: In repentance after sin and heedlessness.

items.title: Make Me One Who Establishes Prayer
items.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
items.transliteration: Rabbi-j'alni muqimas-salati wa min dhurriyyati rabbana wa taqabbal du'a'
items.translation: My Lord, make me one who establishes prayer, and from my descendants as well. Our Lord, accept my supplication.
items.when_to_say: For consistency in salah and righteous children.

items.title: Forgive Me, My Parents, and the Believers
items.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
items.transliteration: Rabbanaghfir li wa liwalidayya wa lilmu'minina yawma yaqumul-hisab
items.translation: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day the reckoning is established.
items.when_to_say: For oneself, parents, and the believers.

items.title: Mercy for My Parents
items.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi irhamhuma kama rabbayani saghira
items.translation: My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small.
items.when_to_say: For one's parents.

items.title: Set Our Affair Rightly
items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmah wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashada
items.translation: Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself and prepare for us right guidance in our affair.
items.when_to_say: When seeking clarity or direction.

items.title: Increase Me in Knowledge
items.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi zidni 'ilma
items.translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
items.when_to_say: Before study, learning, or reading Qur'an.

items.title: Harm Has Touched Me
items.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi inni massaniyad-durru wa anta arhamur-rahimin
items.translation: My Lord, harm has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.
items.when_to_say: During illness, pain, distress, or exhaustion.

items.title: Forgive and Have Mercy
items.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbighfir warham wa anta khayrur-rahimin
items.translation: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.
items.when_to_say: Short repentance and mercy supplication.

items.title: Grant Us Spouses and Children as Comfort
items.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
items.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lilmuttaqina imama
items.translation: Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us leaders for the righteous.
items.when_to_say: For a righteous family and good home life.

items.title: I Am in Need of Whatever Good You Send
items.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
items.transliteration: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir
items.translation: My Lord, truly I am in need of whatever good You send down to me.
items.when_to_say: When in need of help, work, provision, or relief.

items.title: Perfect for Us Our Light
items.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atmim lana nurana waghfir lana innaka 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
items.translation: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Surely You are over all things capable.
items.when_to_say: For forgiveness, light, and a good ending.

items.title: Before Eating
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah
items.translation: In the name of Allah.
items.when_to_say: Before starting food or drink.

items.title: If You Forgot at the Start of Eating
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu
items.translation: In the name of Allah, at its beginning and at its end.
items.when_to_say: If you forgot to say Bismillah before eating and remember during the meal.

items.title: Upon Waking
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
items.translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after causing us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
items.when_to_say: Immediately after waking up.

items.title: Before Sleeping
items.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
items.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya
items.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
items.when_to_say: Before sleeping.

items.title: Leaving the House
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah tawakkaltu 'alallah wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
items.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no power and no strength except with Allah.
items.when_to_say: When stepping out of the house.

items.title: Entering the Home
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلِجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayral-mawliji wa khayral-makhraji bismillahi walajna wa bismillahi kharajna wa 'alallahi rabbina tawakkalna
items.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the best entrance and the best exit. In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we rely.
items.when_to_say: When entering the home.

items.title: Entering the Mosque
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik
items.translation: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.
items.when_to_say: When entering the mosque.

items.title: Leaving the Mosque
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik
items.translation: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.
items.when_to_say: When leaving the mosque.

items.title: After the Adhan
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma rabba hadhihid-da'watit-tammah was-salatil-qa'imah ati Muhammadanil-wasilata wal-fadilah wab'athhu maqaman mahmudan alladhi wa'adtah
items.translation: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the station of الوسيلة and virtue, and raise him to the praised station You promised him.
items.when_to_say: After repeating the adhan.

items.title: Dua for Laylat al-Qadr
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
items.transliteration: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'anni
items.translation: O Allah, You are Pardoning and You love pardon, so pardon me.
items.when_to_say: Especially in the last ten nights of Ramadan and on Laylat al-Qadr.

items.title: Protection with the Perfect Words of Allah
items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
items.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
items.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He created.
items.when_to_say: For protection in general and when entering a place.
